answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, published publicly on failure. The walnut lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the willow is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The dawn of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
